RUNETERRA.Name: Name
RUNETERRA.AbilityActionTooltip: Action: spend an action to use.
RUNETERRA.AbilityReactionTooltip: Reaction: use in response to a trigger.
RUNETERRA.DiceStatusAuto: Automatic from Health and Scene — follows the health zone and the scene color.
RUNETERRA.EnvStatusAuto: Automatic from the Scene — follows the scene color (d6 Green · d8 Yellow · d10 Red). Rolls are whispered to the GM.
RUNETERRA.EnvHelpWhat: the living setting of the scene — the place where the battle happens. Like heroes, it has Power and Quality dice, and its Status die automatically follows the Scene color. It has no Health: it lasts until the end of the scene and cannot be defeated.
RUNETERRA.EnvHelpUse: set the setting's dice (e.g. d10 Time distortion · d8 Mist) and create Twists — events the GM triggers to shake up the scene. Whenever the setting acts (a hazard, an obstacle, the fury of the place itself), click Roll; the result is visible to the GM only.
RUNETERRA.ImportPendingHint: This Champion is empty: the sheet is not filled by hand. Export your character's JSON from the Forja de Campeões website and import it here to build the sheet.
RUNETERRA.MinionPendingExport: Notice: importing Minions and Lieutenants from the Forja is not implemented yet. They should come from a site export (Bullpen); this Minion was made by hand, as a placeholder only.
RUNETERRA.DeleteItemConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this item?
RUNETERRA.NoCharacterData: This champion has no creation data yet — import a character from the Champion Forge website (Phase 7) or fill the data manually.
RUNETERRA.ZoneLocked: Unlocked when your Health reaches this zone
RUNETERRA.SettingsColoredDiceHint: Colors the d4–d12 dice in chat messages.
RUNETERRA.Fan: Disclaimer: unofficial fan project. Runeterra and League of Legends are © Riot Games. Personal, non-commercial use.
RUNETERRA.ModsHint: Drag Mods from the Item Directory or create here. Check the ones included in the roll; the hourglass icon means persistent and the lock, exclusive.
RUNETERRA.SceneHint: Filling a whole zone advances the scene for every champion (changing their Status die). Clicking the last filled space steps back.
RUNETERRA.ReimportConfirm: Update this champion from a newer Forja JSON? The sheet and imported abilities are rebuilt; current Health, mods, Scene and hand-made abilities are kept.
RUNETERRA.VaultPrompt: To import an Antagonist, type the GM vault password. It only lasts for this tab and is not stored.
RUNETERRA.ImportPendingHintAntagonist: This Antagonist is empty: the sheet is not filled by hand. Export the JSON from the Antagonist Forge (GM Screen) and import it here.
RUNETERRA.AntStatusAuto: This archetype's Status die follows the Health zone.
RUNETERRA.AntStatusPick: Click the situation that holds in the scene now.
RUNETERRA.TwistHint: Draws an idea from the GM Screen and sends it to the GM only, in chat. First check the twist questions on the champions' principles.
RUNETERRA.TwistGmOnly: Only the GM sees this message.
RUNETERRA.BackupImported: Screen backup imported: {groups} foe group(s), {challenges} challenge(s).
RUNETERRA.ChHint: A 12+ on Overcome counts as two successes. Timer 0 = no timer; tick a box each turn of the challenge.
RUNETERRA.ClickTraitHint: Click to use this trait in the roll (the Status die follows Health and the Scene automatically).
RUNETERRA.VillainStatusAuto: The Status die is automatic (Temperament + Health + Scene) — Antagonist Status items do not change the die.
RUNETERRA.AbilitiesHint: Abilities and their custom names are managed by the Champion Forge creator and arrive via import.
